rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for avoiding or dodging a person, obstacle, or issue.

example.english: They always sidestep this issue instead of answering.
example.traditional: 佢成日避開呢個問題唔答。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bei6 hoi1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 m4 daap3

rows.note: Use this when someone physically moves to one side or out of the way.

example.english: Please sidestep so the car can pass.
example.traditional: 請你行埋一邊，等架車過。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 haang4 maai4 jat1 bin1 dang2 gaa3 ce1 gwo3
